## Controller navigation in Settings

- **Every Settings screen works with the controller.** The D-pad moves between rows on the Settings tab and on Stream Settings, each PC, Steam and Game Artwork, with the same gold highlight as the game cards. The list scrolls to follow the selection.
- **✕** opens a screen, flips a switch, runs a button, or steps to the next option of a picker. On text fields (API keys, Steam profile, custom resolution) it brings up the keyboard.
- **← / →** change the value of the selected setting: resolution, frame rate, bitrate (±1 Mbps), video codec, touch mode, on-screen controls, and turn switches off/on.
- **○** goes back to the previous screen, or closes the keyboard first if it is open.
- **Remove PC**, **Remove Key & Artwork** and **Disconnect Steam** ask for a second ✕ with the controller ("Press again…"), because the system confirmation dialog can't be driven with a controller. Touch still uses the normal confirmation.
